title: Music City Suite 3500sq ft Walkable to Broadway
description:
Walk to Broadway from our 3,500 sq ft 5th floor suite of The Maddox Hotel.  It is fully loaded, including an air hockey table and board games! The perfect place for group trips, bachelorette / bachelor parties, corporate retreats, executive getaways, business meetings or special occasion birthdays. All the comforts of home but way more fun! Every member of your group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located suite. TPAC, Bridgestone Arena, Titans Stadium, The Gulch, and 2n

The space
This 3500 sq feet suite has 6 bedrooms, 3 full baths (1 of the bathrooms has 3 private shower stalls), and one 1/2 bath. We have a built-in convection/microwave oven, a refrigerator and freezer, separate ice maker, dishwasher, 2-burner induction stove top, an air fryer, crock pot, waffle maker, and toasters. You will be able to whip up the basics, and then some, in the kitchen.

Guest access
This suite is on the 5th floor and you and your guests will have the sole access to the bedrooms, bathrooms, living room, dining room, kitchen and game room. Your code will open the exterior building doors as well as your suite.

Other things to note
There is a downtown grocery store, Savi Urban Market, within walking distance or a Whole Foods and Publix, both a mile away.
